items.heading: Do You Want a Government
items.text: Do You Want a Government Do you want a government-gated door or a private-sector door. Civil services and NET-based teaching run through structured government exams and fixed vacancy or funding cycles. Publishing, content writing, corporate communications, translation, and ELT abroad run through private hiring, portfolios, and certifications instead.

items.heading: Do You Want to Stay
items.text: Do You Want to Stay Do You Want to Stay Do you want to stay inside literature, or use it as a base for something adjacent. Publishing, academia, and creative writing keep you working directly with literary text. Law, civil services, corporate communications, and ELT abroad use the reading, writing, and reasoning skill the degree builds, but apply it to a different subject entirely.

rows: Graduates fluent in a second Indian or foreign language alongside English, who want scarcity-driven pay. Leads this list: it scales fastest, since rarity, not tenure, sets the price.
Fresher translators typically earn Rs 3-5 LPA, mid-career translators Rs 6-10 LPA, and experts in rare language pairs Rs 12-25 LPA or more.
Graduates whose strongest exam skill is reading comprehension and argument, not memorising a new syllabus from zero. Ranks second here for its wide upside ceiling.
CLAT has no age limit and unlimited attempts. Top NLU graduates can start above Rs 15-18 LPA; tier-2 and tier-3 law college outcomes are far more modest.
Graduates who want private-sector income and structured, less creative writing work. Ranks third for its clear, stackable skill-compounding.
Technical writer pay in India commonly runs Rs 4.4 LPA and above at entry, climbing faster with a specific tool or domain skill layered on top.
Graduates who want to stay closest to books and manuscripts, and enjoy line-by-line craft work.
Entry-level editorial assistant roles commonly start around Rs 2-3.5 LPA in Indian publishing houses. Growth is real but slow without a specialised publishing credential.

items.heading: Can You Commit to Another
items.text: Can you commit to another degree, or do you need to start earning sooner. Academia and a Publishing Diploma effectively require another 1-2 years of study. Content writing and a CELTA certification are the two paths on this list that get you into paid work fastest.
